chapter: Germany, Buck's death and ideas about life
title: Choosing show business over school
summary: On Tape 9 he explains pulling Buck from school, since a $50 prize paid more than his father earned in weeks.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: When I said to the Principal of the school it would be much better for us to go to New York with his hands being such a genius on the piano than it would for him to go to school 'cause he'd never learn enough to accumulate enough money as he would make with his hands. When I said that at 13, here's a guy that went to school and finished and everything and found that out, and I did this when I was a kid, the difference between that and he had to live it to learn it. I learned it by accident, to show you what I mean. But I chose the theatrical profession because there was more money in it than it was in jobs, labor jobs. Any time you can go on first (prize) with $50, now you're making a lot of money in less than 10 minutes because at that time my father was getting $18 a week. Do you understand?
